trial_court: First Additional District Judge, Raigarh, Civil Suit No. 17A/1999
case_name: Trilochan And Anr vs Chhattar And Ors.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Trilochan, S/o Gopiram, and others (husband, wife, children)
parties.respondent_defendant: Chhattar, Mst. Munkun Bai, and State of Madhya Pradesh (Now Chhattisgarh), Through: Collector

facts_of_case: The parties are Trilochan's family members and Chhattar, who claimed to be Mahesh Ram's son. The trial court declared Chhattar as Mahesh Ram's son and entitled him to half share of a property. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A party who had ample opportunity to produce certain evidence in the lower court but failed to do so or elected not to do so, cannot have it admitted in appeal.
legal_principles.held: So a party who had ample opportunity to produce certain evidence in the lower court but failed to do so or elected not to do so, cannot have it admitted in appeal.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 41 Rule 27

legal_principles.principle: The appellate court is not entitled to supplement the evidence adduced by one party or the other in the lower court.
legal_principles.held: Hence, in the absence of satisfactory reasons for the non-production of the evidence in the trial court, additional evidence should not be admitted in appeal as a party guilty of remissness in the lower court is not entitled to the indulgence of being allowed to give further evidence under this Rule.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 41 Rule 27

legal_principles.principle: The two tests for admissibility of additional evidence are whether the appellate court is able to pronounce judgment on the material before it, without taking into consideration the additional evidence sought to be adduced.
legal_principles.held: Such occasion would arise only if on examine the evidence, as it stands the court comes to the conclusion that some inherent lacuna or defects becomes apparent to the court. It is only for removing a lacuna in the evidence, that the appellate court is empowered to admit additional evidence.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 41 Rule 27

legal_principles.principle: A party who failed to discharge its onus before the trial court is not entitled to a fresh opportunity to produce evidence.
legal_principles.held: When a party failed to discharge its onus before the trial court, he is not entitled to a fresh opportunity to produce evidence.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 41 Rule 27

outcome.final_order: The final order confirms the trial court's decision, declaring Chhattar as Mahesh Ram's son and entitled to half share of the property.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for property dispute resolution
